title: POSCO inks long-term lithium supply deal with CATL
dek: POSCO has signed a long-term lithium supply deal with CATL, according to a Maeil Business headline.
summary: A headline on mkbn. mk.co. kr reports that POSCO has signed a long-term lithium supply agreement with CATL. No excerpt was provided, so volumes, duration and value are not stated.
keyFacts: POSCO signs long-term lithium supply deal with CATL
whyItMatters: The deal concerns battery materials rather than steel, but reflects the POSCO group's push to build non-steel revenue streams.
implications: Little direct effect on steel trade; it may influence how investors value the group's diversification strategy.
